description: This file defines the ArticlesController class, which handles HTTP requests related to articles in the web API. It includes actions for retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles, utilizing Mediator pattern commands and queries.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class managing article-related endpoints, including listing, detail view, creation, editing, and deletion.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of articles with optional filters.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a personalized feed of articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a single article by slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to edit an existing article by slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article by slug, requiring authorization.
